Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package graph;

public class DSU {
    int[] parent;
    int[] rank;

    public DSU(int n) {
        parent = new int[n];
        rank = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            parent[i] = i;
        }
    }

    // path compression
    public int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) return parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    }

    // union by rank
    public void union(int u, int v) {
        int pu = find(u);
        int pv = find(v);
        if (pu == pv) return;
        if (rank[pu] < rank[pv]) parent[pu] = pv;
        else if (rank[pu] > rank[pv]) parent[pv] = pu;
        else {
            parent[pv] = pu;
            rank[pu]++;
        }
    }

    public boolean connected(int x, int y) {
        return find(x) == find(y);
    }


    public static void main(String[] args) {
        DSU dsu = new DSU(7);

        dsu.union(0, 1);
        dsu.union(1, 2);
        dsu.union(3, 4);

        System.out.println(dsu.connected(0, 2)); // true
        System.out.println(dsu.connected(0, 4)); // false

        dsu.union(2, 4);

        System.out.println(dsu.connected(0, 4)); // true
    }
}
